description: Amtech and Skill Connect — every event ships as a kit: pavilion banners, case-study walls, standees, folders.
story: Events are where the brand meets strangers. For Amtech the institute stood beside Japanese industrial giants, so the pavilion spoke their language: engineering photography, case-study walls, restraint. Skill Connect went the other way — standees, photo frames and folders that make a career fair feel like a launch.
